finding: The steps to refresh installed Codex stubs (delete the `afk-afk-*.toml` copies, then run `/afk:setup` so O5 copies them again) are now written out in full in two places in PROVIDERS.md, and the two wordings already differ.
why: AGENTS.md requires one home per fact. With two copies, a later fix to the refresh steps (for example, if setup starts comparing file content) will update one line and leave the other stale.
fix: Keep the steps in one line, for example the 'Spawn AFK role' row at line 23, and have line 157 point to it instead of repeating them.
evidence: AGENTS.md: "DRY — one fact, one home. State each fact (enumeration, format, recipe, rule) in exactly ONE file — its owning file — every other skill *points* by path, never restates." PROVIDERS.md:23 "delete the `afk-afk-*.toml` copies in `~/.codex/agents/`, then run `/afk:setup`, whose register entry O5 (`skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md`) copies the renamed stubs" and PROVIDERS.md:157 "Codex users then delete the `afk-afk-*.toml` copies in `~/.codex/agents/` and re-run `/afk:setup`, whose register entry O5 (`skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md`) copies the TOMLs again."
